name: Munera
tagline: Considered merch, from one hoodie to ten thousand.
positioning: Munera is the branded-merch platform for individuals and small teams who want real, well-made swag without minimums, mockup headaches, or shipping chaos.

hero.h1: Swag worth putting your name on.
hero.sub: Design once, order what you actually need, and let Munera handle print, packing, and tracked delivery — whether it's a single embroidered cap or a full team kit.

features.title: No minimums, ever
features.description: Order one heavyweight tee or five hundred. We price fairly at every quantity so a personal project isn't stuck behind a bulk order.

features.title: Real proofs, not guesses
features.description: See a photoreal mockup on the actual garment before you pay, with stitch counts and Pantone matches confirmed by a human.

features.title: Warehousing on demand
features.description: Store finished merch with us and ship items one at a time as people claim them — no boxes stacking up in your hallway.

features.title: Vetted, durable blanks
features.description: We stock organic cotton, recycled fleece, and hardware that survives a hundred washes. Every SKU is quality-checked on arrival.

features.title: Live production tracking
features.description: Follow each order from artwork approval through print, pack, and courier hand-off with timestamped status updates.

features.title: Reorder in one click
features.description: Saved designs, sizes, and color specs stay on file so restocking your favorite hoodie takes seconds, not a support ticket.

testimonials.quote: I run a two-person design studio and needed forty branded totes for a launch. Munera turned my logo into a proof overnight and shipped clean, evenly-printed bags four days later. No account manager runaround.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

testimonials.quote: We used to eat 300-piece minimums just to get decent embroidery. Now I order twelve caps for new hires as they start, and the stitch quality is genuinely better than our old vendor.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: The on-demand warehousing sold me. My newsletter readers claim a shirt, Munera ships it, and I never touch a box. It feels like having a fulfillment team without hiring one.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitlock

For growing companies with recurring merch programs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Munera makes branded merch that people actually keep — printed on demand, warehoused for you, and shipped anywhere without minimums.
